# The HR-16's memory dump: made by test/gen_sysex_test.py from its service manual's format, do not edit. A
# dump from an HR-16 replaces the drum patterns (hits, lengths, each one's VOICE, TUNE and MIX); MIDI DUMP
# (the drum page's last function) and its request send them back the same, its header as it was.

usb plug
tap ARP
wait 30

# pattern 00's first hits: the kick, the crash (pad 5), the mid hat (pad 7), each dynamics as a velocity
expect drhpad1 1
expect drhvel1 127
expect drhpad2 5
expect drhvel2 95
expect drhpad3 7
expect drhvel3 47
# its sounds on the pads, each its drum's pad's in the kit (the HR-16's): a gated kick the KICK's, the
# crash the CRASH's, the foot hat the CLS HAT's, a 10" power tom TOM 1's, a tambourine on PERC 2 PERC 3's;
# a cowbell none; levels, pans, tunings
expect padsnd1 0
expect padlevel1 90
expect padpan1 0
expect padsnd2 1
expect padtune2 1
expect padpan2 -1
expect padsnd5 13
expect padlevel5 99
expect padsnd7 2
expect padsnd9 8
expect padsnd13 -1
expect padhr1613 42
expect padsnd14 6
expect padhr1614 45
expect padtune9 1
expect padfine9 2
expect padlevel9 65
# a step up, the MID HAT's: TUNE +1, FINE -7; a step down, PERC 2's (pad 14): -1, +7
expect padtune7 1
expect padfine7 -7
expect padtune14 -1
expect padfine14 7
# its notes the pads': the KICK on 35 (the HR-16's), the MID HAT (pad 7) 44, PERC 4 (pad 16) 61
expect padnote1 35
expect padnote7 44
expect padnote16 61
wait 1300
shot hr16_in.png
# MANUAL VOICE/TUNE/MIX (the function before MIDI DUMP): off as it came; on, every pattern plays the global
# set-up (the KICK's level 99, not pattern 00's 90; PERC 1 the kit's timbale, not none), off again its own
expect drmanual 0
turn ALGO 9
wait 30
expect drfn 9
turn K1 1
wait 30
expect drmanual 1
expect padlevel1 99
expect padsnd13 14
turn K1 -1
wait 30
expect drmanual 0
expect padlevel1 90
expect padsnd13 -1
# MIDI DUMP (the drum page's last function): REC sends them back, byte for byte the dump that came (each
# drum's sound as it came)
turn ALGO 10
wait 30
expect drfn 10
wait 1300
shot hr16_dump.png
sysex_out
tap REC
wait 300
